نمتحن (form VIII)
# نَمْتَحِنُ (namtaḥinu) /nam.ta.ħi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# نُمْتَحَنُ (numtaḥanu) /num.ta.ħa.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# نَمْتَحِنَ (namtaḥina) /nam.ta.ħi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# نُمْتَحَنَ (numtaḥana) /num.ta.ħa.na/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
